DesignProject.title: DesignProject
DesignProject.description: A cloud-saved interior, exterior, or full home architectural design project owned by a user.

spaceType.description: Design scope: interior, exterior, or both.

roomCategory.description: Primary room or facade category (1 to 60 chars).

areaSqm.description: Project floor or plot area in square meters.

promptSummary.description: Summary of the design prompt or architectural brief.

renderSettings.description: Compact summary of render aspect ratio, resolution, lighting, and lens.

thumbnailBase64.description: Optional compressed JPEG base64 thumbnail of the latest render.

estimatedTotalTry.description: Estimated total material cost in Turkish Lira.

phase.description: Project workflow phase; TESLIM is terminal.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server last-update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

MaterialItem.title: MaterialItem
MaterialItem.description: A bill-of-materials line item belonging to a user's design project.

name.description: Material or fixture name (1 to 120 chars).

unit.description: Measurement unit such as m2, adet, m3, kg, mt.

unitPriceTry.description: Estimated unit price in Turkish Lira.

purchased.description: Whether the material has been procured.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server last-update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

ChatMessageRecord.title: ChatMessageRecord
ChatMessageRecord.description: A persisted AI architect chatbot message owned by the user.

thinkingUsed.description: Whether high-thinking architectural analysis mode was active.
